contrarian_views.consensus_belief: Gold is a safe haven — buy and hold for protection
contrarian_views.contrarian_read: Gold positioning is at extreme levels. The 'safe haven' trade is now the consensus trade, which paradoxically makes it less safe. A sharp reversal is possible on any USD strength catalyst.
evidence: Gold specs net long at 44.8% OI — extreme crowding
Gold YTD: +9.3% — strong rally fueling the crowd
contrarian_views.actionability: Trim long gold positions or buy put protection. Don't initiate new longs at these positioning levels.

contrarian_views.consensus_belief: Credit is fine — spreads are tight, no systemic risk
contrarian_views.contrarian_read: Credit spreads are lagging equity vol — the divergence between tight HY spreads and wide BDC NAV discounts suggests credit hasn't repriced to match equity fear. Spreads typically widen with a lag when VIX sustains above 25.
evidence: BDCs at -14.5% NAV discount — public market pricing credit losses that private funds haven't marked
contrarian_views.actionability: Underweight HY bonds. If BDC NAV discounts widen past -20%, that's the signal that credit stress is becoming real.

contrarian_views.consensus_belief: Inflation is transitory / under control — the Fed will handle it
contrarian_views.contrarian_read: Multiple inflation signals are flashing while markets still price a 'soft landing' — the risk is that inflation proves stickier than consensus expects, forcing the Fed to hold rates higher for longer.
contrarian_views.actionability: Overweight commodities and TIPS. Underweight long-duration bonds. Energy sector leadership is a proxy for this thesis.

contrarian_views.consensus_belief: Private market valuations are reasonable — the denominator effect is manageable and marks will hold
contrarian_views.contrarian_read: Public proxies are screaming that private marks are stale. GP stock weakness signals the market expects fee/carry impairment. The next wave of quarterly marks will likely show write-downs, creating forced selling by funds hitting allocation limits.
evidence: PE/VC exit window is narrowing — cannot realize investments
PE GP stocks down -23% YTD — market doubts fee/carry revenue
Private Credit: BDC index at -14.5% NAV discount → write_down_risk
contrarian_views.actionability: Avoid new commitments to private credit funds. Watch for GP-led secondary sales as forced liquidity events — these create opportunity for buyers.
